_comment: Authored domain skills. One entry per skill directory under domain-skills/.
tools: name is what the description must claim; check/install are exact
strings that must appear in the SKILL.md or its references.
keywords feed the deterministic routing proxy in tests/routing.json —
they are a lint, not a learned router (see docs/decisions.md).

skills.name: evidence-notes
skills.provenance: Authored for this repo. Facts drawn from morluto/rea (REA Evidence report shape, package rea-agents 6.8.0) and mem0ai/mem0 (scoped memory contract: user_id/agent_id/session_id, search-before-store), both inspected 2026-11-02 (commits in docs/capability-matrix.md), MIT and Apache-2.0 respectively. No upstream text copied; redaction pattern list is standard practice.

skills.name: re-triage
skills.provenance: Authored for this repo. Tool facts verified against morluto/rea (rea-agents 6.8.0: doctor proves only setup-owned registrations; 15 platform domains; npm engines ranges), bethington/ghidra-mcp (bridge-mcp-ghidra, 219 tools, Ghidra 12.x/Java 21), HexRaysSA/ida-mcp (IDA 9.4+, uvx ida-hcli mcp install), icsharpcode/ILSpy (dotnet tool ilspycmd), SamboyCoding/Cpp2IL (--list-output-formats). All inspected 2026-11-02, commits in docs/capability-matrix.md. REA's own skill is not vendored; the not-carried list lives in references/tool-matrix.md.

skills.name: re-native
skills.provenance: Authored for this repo. Facts from bethington/ghidra-mcp (Apache-2.0; Python bridge bridge-mcp-ghidra, setup via python -m tools.setup preflight, Ghidra 12.x, Java 21, 219-tool catalogue) and HexRaysSA/ida-mcp (MIT; IDA Pro 9.4+ via IDALIB, Python 3.11+, install uvx ida-hcli mcp install), inspected 2026-11-02. Decompiler-output-is-hypothesis framing is field consensus, stated in own words.

skills.name: re-managed
skills.provenance: Authored for this repo. Facts from icsharpcode/ILSpy (MIT; ilspycmd flags -l/--list-resources/-t/-m/-il verified in ICSharpCode.ILSpyCmd source at the inspected commit) and SamboyCoding/Cpp2IL (MIT; output formats dll_il_recovery/dll_throw_null/diffable-cs verified in Cpp2IL.Core; recovered bodies can be stubs or exception bodies and recovered IL is known-messy — the brief's 'still stubs?' question answered: partial recovery, verify natively). Inspected 2026-11-02.

skills.name: appsec-strix
skills.provenance: Authored for this repo. Facts from usestrix/strix (Apache-2.0): same binary drives OSS (Docker + own LLM key via STRIX_LLM) and cloud (strix cloud, no Docker); check strix --version; install pipx/uv/pip strix-agent or upstream script; its own skills install via npx skills add usestrix/strix and own all flag detail. Also consistent with the four strix method skills already vendored into one-skill. Inspected 2026-11-02 at the refreshed pin.

skills.name: modder-bridge
skills.provenance: Authored for this repo. Facts from rehan-remade/universal-modder (MIT): CLI `um` (um --version, um kb search), workflow KB-first -> recon -> backed-up lab -> source -> vertical slice -> verify in the real game -> package; hard rules against anti-cheat/DRM/ownership bypass; skills install via npx skills add. Inspected 2026-11-02. Workflow restated in own words at bridge altitude; its skills are not vendored.
